questions.question: ________ compares neighbouring elements only and swaps them when necessary.
questions.explanation: Bubble sort repeatedly compares adjacent elements and swaps them if out of order. Selection sort finds the minimum of the unsorted part and swaps it into place.

questions.question: Which of the following is not an e-Reservation portal in India?
questions.explanation: Yatra, MakeMyTrip and IRCTC are travel and ticket reservation portals, while Amazon.in is primarily an online shopping (e-retail) site.

questions.question: The necessary condition to be checked before deletion from the queue is

options.D: More than one of the above

questions.explanation: Before deleting (dequeuing) we must check for underflow, i.e. whether the queue is empty. Overflow is checked before insertion.

questions.question: Which one of the following is the correct definition of "is_array();" function in C++?

options.A: It checks that the specified variable is of the array or not
options.B: It checks that the specified array is of single dimension or not
options.C: It checks that the specified array is of multi-dimension or not
options.D: More than one of the above

questions.explanation: std::is_array checks whether the given type is an array type or not, regardless of its number of dimensions.

questions.question:
Evaluate the given postfix expression:
3 5 * 6 + 2 3 * -
questions.explanation: 3 5 * gives 15; 15 6 + gives 21; 2 3 * gives 6; 21 6 - gives 15.

questions.question: The method of accessing the I/O devices by repeatedly checking the status flags is

options.D: More than one of the above

questions.explanation: In program-controlled I/O the processor repeatedly checks (polls) device status flags to see if the device is ready. Memory-mapped and I/O-mapped refer to addressing schemes, not to polling.

questions.question: Pick the incorrect statement about inline functions in C++.

options.A: They save overhead of a return call from a function.
options.B: They are generally very large and complicated function.
options.C: These functions are inserted/substituted at the point of call.
options.D: More than one of the above

questions.explanation: Inline functions are meant to be small; their body is substituted at the call site, saving call/return overhead. Saying they are generally large and complicated is incorrect.

questions.question: In the OSI model, which layer is responsible for routing and forwarding data packets?
questions.explanation: Routing and forwarding of packets is done by the Network layer (layer 3), which is not among the options, so the answer is None of the above.

questions.question: Which of the following attributes is not a valid attribute of the <font> tag in HTML?
questions.explanation: The (legacy) <font> tag takes face, size and color attributes; type is not one of them.

questions.question: The necessary condition to be checked before deletion from the queue is

options.D: More than one of the above

questions.explanation: Before deleting (dequeue), we must check for underflow, i.e. whether the queue is empty. Overflow is checked before insertion.

questions.question: Which command will you choose to convert a column of data into row?
questions.explanation: Edit > Paste Special > Transpose converts a column into a row. Plain cut and paste keeps the same orientation.

questions.question:
Identify the output of the following code segment:
s = "an apple. a toy."
s = s.find('a', 2)
print(s)
questions.explanation: In "an apple. a toy.", index 0 is 'a', 1 is 'n', 2 is a space and 3 is 'a'. find('a', 2) starts searching at index 2, so it returns 3.

questions.question: Which model considers risk assessment and incremental development in software projects?
questions.explanation: Boehm's Spiral model combines iterative, incremental development with explicit risk analysis in every cycle. Waterfall is sequential without risk-driven iteration.

questions.question: A* search algorithm is based on?
questions.explanation: A* is a best-first search that selects nodes with the lowest f(n) = g(n) + h(n). It generalises uniform cost search by adding a heuristic, but it is classified as a best-first search.

questions.question: If you press ..........., the cell accepts your typing as its contents.
questions.explanation: Pressing Enter confirms the typing as the cell's contents and moves down. Alt+Enter only inserts a line break inside the cell.

questions.question: What difference do the fifth generation computers have from other generation computers?

options.D: More than one of the above

questions.explanation: Each generation of computers is distinguished by technological advancement (fifth generation: ULSI, AI, parallel processing). Object-oriented programming and scientific code are not what defines the generation.

questions.question: Which of the following is the first and foremost step in Image Processing?
questions.explanation: Image acquisition (capturing and digitizing the image) is the first step; enhancement, restoration and segmentation come later.

questions.question: For designing a normal RDBMS, which of the following normal forms is considered adequate?

options.D: More than one of the above

questions.explanation: For most practical relational database designs, 3NF is considered adequate. 2NF still leaves transitive dependencies, and 4NF is rarely necessary.

questions.concept: Char arrays cannot be concatenated with +

options.D: More than one of the above

questions.explanation: s1 and " " decay to pointers, and adding two pointers with + is not allowed, so the code fails to compile. Concatenation with + works only for std::string objects.

questions.question: Which traversal algorithm is typically implemented using a stack data structure?
questions.explanation: Depth-first search uses a stack (explicitly or via recursion) to go deep before backtracking, while BFS uses a queue. Hence only DFS fits.

questions.question: The data structure used to represent the allocation status of main memory is known as:
questions.explanation: The OS keeps a memory map (e.g. bitmap or free list) recording which parts of main memory are allocated and which are free. A page table maps pages to frames for one process, and FAT tracks disk blocks.

questions.concept: Switch is not an edge device
questions.question: Which of the following is not a network edge device?
questions.explanation: End systems such as PCs, smartphones and servers are at the network edge; switches and routers are interconnecting (core) devices.

questions.question: Which of the following is done by Secure Sockets Layer?

options.A: Creates a secure, private connection to a web server

questions.explanation: SSL establishes a secure, private connection to a web server, encrypts the information exchanged, and sends it over the internet, so all three apply.

questions.question: How many inputs does a full-adder circuit have for each individual binary digit being added or subtracted?
questions.explanation: A full adder takes three inputs per bit position: A, B and the carry-in. A half adder has only two inputs.

questions.question: The language accepted by Push down Automaton:
questions.explanation: A pushdown automaton accepts exactly the context-free languages. Linear bounded automata accept context-sensitive languages and Turing machines (that halt) recursive ones.
